label: Open
means: loose in a public space, or an unlocked container anyone may use (no owner, or the town)

label: Private
means: owned and unlocked, inside a home or behind a counter: taking it is stealing

label: Well locked
means: an Adept lock, or hidden (under a floor, behind a panel)

label: Strong
means: an Expert lock, in a guarded or private upper room

label: Vault
means: a Master lock or a key-only lock, guarded
